verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an official MCP server that lets an AI client "work with segments" through natural-language prompts, and states plainly that your AI client can "build segments." A CLI also gives agents full access to the Journeys UI API, and the in-app "Describe segment" agent builds segments from plain-text descriptions, which shows the platform itself performs this translation. Missing for 10: no hands-on or independent corroboration of an external agent creating a segment end-to-end, and no detailed documentation of the segment-creation tool or endpoint and the condition types it supports.
